dataExport.user.title: Export your data
dataExport.user.description: Download an archive of your profile, memberships, and the todos, notes, assistant conversations, and attachment details you created in the organizations you belong to. Attachment files are not included.

dataExport.organization.description: Download an archive of this organization: its members, roles, invitations, todos, notes, and attachment details. Assistant conversations stay private: each member exports their own from account settings. Attachment files are not included.
